$comment: Loopback development identities. /signin-with-chatgpt signs in as `defaultIdentity`; /signin-with-chatgpt?as=<id> as a persona (build/sites-vite-plugin.ts). `npm run seed:demo` gives each persona its role in a demo practice (scripts/seed-demo.mjs). Never used by a build.

personas.name: QA Lead
personas.purpose: Leads and administers the demo practice; lead sign-off and client access grants.

personas.name: QA Auditor
personas.purpose: Prepares working papers and procedures on the Acme engagement.

personas.name: QA Reviewer
personas.purpose: Independent reviewer on the Acme engagement.

personas.name: QA Second Lead
personas.purpose: A second Lead Auditor for independent approvals; also leads a practice of their own, so practice switching is reachable.

personas.name: QA Quality Reviewer
personas.purpose: Engagement Quality Reviewer outside the Acme engagement team: stand-back checklist and package sign-off; reads but never edits audit work.

personas.name: QA Client Contributor
personas.purpose: Acme staff member who answers the seeded evidence request in the client portal.

personas.name: QA Client Viewer
personas.purpose: Acme staff member who sees released reports only.

personas.name: QA Outsider
personas.purpose: Not a member of the demo practice; the first sign-in provisions a separate practice, for isolation checks.
